extension.description: Every picture hangs like a gallery print in a bevel-cut mat, and the paper takes its colour from the artwork in focus. Geist throughout, museum captions, no outlines. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.11 - Library card (Left or Right past the edge of a view, or the Options word): update and clean the library, view, sort, order, show, search; a view picker with previews in the header; album page buttons readable again.
